text: APPROVE: The split into `StartTopLevel`, `ReadNested`, `ReadImporterLine` and `ReadPackageLine` keeps the original branch order, conditions and line numbers (`i + 1` is passed through). Each new method scores well under 15 on cognitive complexity, and `Read` is now a simple loop. Nullable flow analysis still narrows `state.Importer` and `state.PackageKey` where needed, so the build should stay clean. I could not build it or see the hidden top of the loop, so this rests on reading the diff; a StyleCop member-ordering rule, if the project enables one, is the only thing that could trip the warnings-as-errors build.
